summary: SCHEMA-LEAK FIX VERIFIED. Promoted inline admin guards to Depends(require_admin) on all 5 payment/webhook simulate endpoints. New pytest suite (15 cases) + prior regression suite (20 cases) = 35/35 PASS. Anon and non-admin free user now receive 401/403 (never 422) for empty bodies, and no Pydantic body-validation schema field names leak. Admin positive control confirms guard still passes admin through: 422 on the 4 payment endpoints (empty body -> Pydantic validation) and 200 on webhook (no required body).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is clean and idiomatic — Depends(require_admin) is the canonical FastAPI pattern for auth-before-body-validation.
All 5 endpoints now share the same guard (routes/db.py:773 require_admin), which enforces admin risk profile and emits admin_access_denied security events on failure.

Non-admin non-anon on /api/webhook-events/simulate hits upstream subscription-tier middleware first (returns a 'Subscription Required' 403 with current_plan/required_plan text). This is orthogonal to the schema-leak fix — still 403 (not 422), and the 'plan' text refers to subscription tier, not the endpoint's request schema. Not a security regression.
